# 10. Crimes and Fines
Server rules must be followed, but the Frontier Sector Code can be broken with some considerations.
- Capital crimes should only be committed by antagonists (e.g. pirates, nuclear operatives). - All other crimes require proper roleplay, justification and escalation to be committed as a non-antagonist. - If a silicon is responsible for a crime, the person giving the order is to be charged. - Punishment can compound depending on the number of counts of a single crime and the severity. -- Refer to the [textlink="Frontier Sector Code" link="FrontierCode"] for a list of offenses, fines, punishments, and limits. - Do not loot, salvage, or claim a vessel that has a valid deed unless it has been left unpowered in space for more than four days. -- Unregistered or deedless vessels are salvageable under the Frontier Sector Code.
